subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘SQUARE’ is written as ‘UQSERA’ and ‘CIRCLE’ is written as ‘RICELC’, how will ‘EQUATE’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First three letters → Written diagonally.
 
• Last three letters → Written diagonally.

​​So,

 
• ‘SQUARE’ is written as ‘UQSERA’

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/525c70e7fc63f80f972f78738574097033b1376f1511218f8e1e104f5c2fcca9.png] 

​And,

 
• ‘CIRCLE’ is written as ‘RICELC’

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77a72ff5880f559b1d432fbd061a8e7d1c8207a14337f11c56fdd51a4e0f4c79.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘EQUATE’ is written as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d01ed49ca91351867151bba8867adcc6839ea1cd36397cd1b5ffb537b3755f8.png] 

Hence, "**UQEETA**" is the correct answer.
